title: Stewart Belland & Associates Inc.
description: Stewart Belland & Associates Inc. (SBA) is a Civil Enforcement Agency licensed by the Province of Alberta. Operating since 1996, under the Alberta Civil Enforcement Act and Regulations, as a Civil Enforcement Agency we are legislated to enforce Civil Warrants.SBA retains the services of Provincial Licensed Bailiffs, who follow a compressive Rule of Conduct, in performing their functions throughout all jurisdictions within the Province of Alberta.
